post_measurement_diagnostic.interpretation: SIGQUIT follows measured end and 40 successful requests; preserved shutdown diagnostic, not counted as a measured failure. Its generic message alone does not establish a child computation failure.

limits: This is one C4 single-run comparison, not the final 16-point refreshed campaign or a repeat estimate.
The new SGLang commit, physical node, tuning/cache state, and historical per-arm runtimes differ. These observations do not isolate the causal benefit of autotuning.

C256 and C4 startup intervals are not pooled; C256 prepares 10 Mega capacities and 27 graph batch sizes, whereas C4 prepares 4 capacities and one graph batch size. Loading, JIT, other operators, and cache state also differ.

The persisted snapshot is captured after startup and before measured requests. Cache-hit log lines plus byte-identical target native cache files establish reuse; the filename before.json does not mean before server launch.
The draft namespace retains copies of Mega payloads but is not proof the draft runs Mega; its resolved backend is TRT-LLM/none and its log still shows BF16 MoE tuning.
Median and percentile latencies are reported client aggregates checked against the saved report; per-request latency arrays were not saved, so quantiles cannot be independently reconstructed.
Streaming ITL is retained in raw milliseconds and not substituted for TPOT/interactivity; stream_interval=30 means it is not a token-by-token interval measure.
Six sealed source archives remain deferred locally; final campaign archival/acceptance is still pending. No quality evaluation was run.
